title: Evening Sunwatch
text:
🌇 Evening Sunwatch — October 29, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B2.1)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B6.4 (Peaked October 28, 2026 at 12:52 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 325 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 0.33)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

Things are pretty quiet. 💫☀️

Several bright coronal regions and a broad dark EUV area are visible today, with no obvious large outward structure in the coronagraph.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 131 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
